boundary_evidence: One contiguous run 0x01ffd97c..0x01ffdb28, 2 functions, gapless in config/arm9/itcm/delinks.txt: the ITCM part of the Nitro SDK's os_irqHandler.c, OS_IrqHandler (IRQ::UserInterruptHandler) then OS_IrqHandler_ThreadSwitch (func_01ffd9d4). The two are coupled directly: UserInterruptHandler preloads lr with func_01ffd9d4 before jumping to the dispatched handler, and func_01ffd9d4 has no frame of its own -- its exits are `ldr pc, [sp], #4`, popping the lr UserInterruptHandler pushed.
